name: Queen of the South
description: Teresa flees Mexico after her drug-runner boyfriend is murdered. Settling in Dallas, she looks to become the country's reigning drug smuggler and to avenge her lover's murder.

videos.title: Piloto
videos.overview: When the Mexican drug cartel comes after Teresa Mendoza with a vengeance, she is forced to run and do whatever it takes to survive. Now, her fate is sealed in the dangerous narco world forever.

videos.title: Cuarenta Minutos
videos.overview: Teresa has to prove her worth to Camila. Meanwhile, Epifanio gets closer in his hunt for Teresa. Back in Mexico, Brenda desperately tries to find Teresa and hide from the cartel.

videos.title: Estrategia de Entrada
videos.overview: Camila sends Teresa out on a major drug operation to test her loyalty. In secret, Camila makes her first big move to take over Epifanio’s cartel. Meanwhile, Brenda plots her escape to America.

videos.title: Lirio de los Valles
videos.overview: A deadly mistake mars Teresa’s first solo drug run and she soon finds herself in peril. Meanwhile, Brenda and Tony make the risky escape to Dallas.

videos.title: Un Alma. Un Mapa. Dos Futuros.
videos.overview: Teresa witnesses a horrific event that forces her to advance her plans. Now, safely in Dallas, Brenda needs money to survive, and starts assembling a rag tag team to help her sell drugs.

videos.title: El Engaño como la Regla
videos.overview: Camila, riddled with debt and short on supply, grows desperate and ponders giving Teresa up. Meanwhile, Brenda's burgeoning drug enterprise creates a rift between her and Tony.

videos.title: El Hombre Pájaro
videos.overview: Camila sends Teresa out on a life-threatening, multi- million dollar midnight mission. Pressured by a lack of supply, Brenda puts her crew in the line of fire.

videos.title: Billete de Magia
videos.overview: A desperate Camila attempts an incredibly risky heist. Meanwhile, Teresa goes undercover and, with her life on the line, is forced to make a choice that forever changes her.

videos.title: Coge Todo Lo Que Puede Llevar
videos.overview: Teresa races to save a witness in the recent heist. With renewed confidence, Camila assures her partners that she’s back in business and vows to be done with Epifanio once and for all.

videos.title: Esta ‘Cosa’ Que Es Nuestra
videos.overview: Camila returns to Mexico to protect her life, while James hunts Teresa down. Meanwhile Teresa finds herself in grave danger taking Maria through the tunnel to Mexico.

videos.title: Punto Sin Retorno
videos.overview: Aligning with the Jimenez Cartel, Camila’s operation goes underground. Teresa and Brenda try to start a new life utilizing knowledge from Güero’s book.

videos.title: Quinientos Mil
videos.overview: Teresa and Brenda risk everything in a game of extortion. Camila takes further steps to overtake Epifanio’s empire.

videos.title: Cicatriz
videos.overview: Teresa risks her life to protect Güero’s book by any means necessary. Camila’s takeover becomes rocky and Epifanio gets new intel that changes everything.

videos.title: El Cuerpo de Cristo
videos.overview: Teresa brokers a deal with an eccentric smuggler, Camila struggles to rebuild her empire, and Epifanio takes on a new partner he may not be able to control.

videos.title: Dios y el Abogado
videos.overview: Teresa and crew rig a high-stakes narco horse race, but old enemies — and old flames — threaten to tear everything apart.

videos.title: Un Pacto con el Diablo
videos.overview: While trying to destroy Epifanio's drug smuggling tunnels, Teresa and James come face-to-face with a group of American border vigilantes.

videos.title: El Beso de Judas
videos.overview: Teresa's loyalties are tested when she is asked to assassinate a DEA mole.

videos.title: El Nacimiento de Bolivia
videos.overview: Teresa and her companions go to Bolivia to find the notorious supplier El Santo, but their hunt is complicated by a soldier waging a personal vendetta.

videos.title: El Camino de la Muerte
videos.overview: Held captive by a twisted cult led by El Santo, Teresa is forced to make a terrible choice that leads her to lose her mental grasp on reality.

videos.title: El Precio de Fe
videos.overview: Epifanio spots red flags near his daughter. Camila and Teresa find a mobster who can move a ton of coke, but they'll have to steal him from Epifanio.

videos.title: Sacar con Sifon el Mar
videos.overview: Unable to take no for an answer, Camila sends Teresa and the crew to Chicago to give Devon Finch's tastemaker a mind-changing sample of their coke.

videos.title: Sólo El Amor De Una Madre
videos.overview: Camila and Teresa meet with Devon Finch to negotiate a deal, unaware they're being followed. At a memorial in Sinaloa, Epifanio offers Boaz a proposal.

videos.title: Que Manden los Payasos
videos.overview: While searching through her husband's documents for evidence incriminating Camila, Kelly Ann finds something that she must show to Teresa right away.

videos.title: La Noche Oscura del Alma
videos.overview: When Teresa and Kelly Ann go on the run, James's loyalties are put to the test. An oversight enables Agent Loya to track down the two fugitives.

videos.title: Todas las Horas Hieren
videos.overview: To pay El Santo, Teresa recruits an army to steal the coke and cash from Camila's men. Camila's transfer to a maximum-security prison is interrupted.

videos.title: La Última Hora Mata
videos.overview: A video of Isabela reveals a clue as to her whereabouts. Teresa gets a nasty surprise when she goes to collect Devon Finch's payment for the cocaine.

videos.title: La Ermitaña
videos.overview: With Camila out for blood, Teresa retreats to Malta, where she considers an enticing deal with a European money launderer.

videos.title: El Colgado
videos.overview: A familiar face reappears to help Teresa escape assassins and the police. Wondering who she can trust, she plans her next move.

videos.title: Reina de Oros
videos.overview: Even as she cements her deal with her European contact, Teresa risks everything when she discovers he traffics in more than just cryptocurrency.

videos.title: La Fuerza
videos.overview: Teresa flees Malta to start fresh in Phoenix, Arizona. But her U.S. base has its own problems: hostile, local cartel bosses and a corrupt sheriff.

videos.title: El Juicio
videos.overview: An old enemy seeking revenge and information attacks Teresa’s operation, and she must decide where her loyalties lie.

videos.title: Los Enamorados
videos.overview: In captivity, Teresa reunites with a close ally, and the two plan their escape. Camila, meanwhile, struggles to balance business, family and revenge.

videos.title: Reina De Espadas
videos.overview: Teresa mourns a devastating loss, but business must go on as she faces a dangerous situation and forges a pivotal alliance.

videos.title: El Carro
videos.overview: When her plan to become the sole drug distributor in Phoenix turns bloody, Teresa readies for war and makes a deal with the devil.

videos.title: El Diablo
videos.overview: Change rocks two empires as Teresa moves against her enemies in Phoenix and Camila faces a mutiny within her own organization.

videos.title: La Muerte
videos.overview: A mysterious summons leads Teresa to Bolivia for a reckoning with her supplier, El Santo.

videos.title: Diez de Copas
videos.overview: Teresa uncovers a mole in her operation and must make a heartbreaking choice that tests her loyalties.

videos.title: Justicia
videos.overview: Bitter enemies come together for shared goals, and a failed rescue mission inspires a scheme to recover an ally and locate a foe.

videos.title: El Mundo
videos.overview: Following a surprise attack, Teresa mounts a counterassault to secure her empire and eliminate her rivals once and for all.

videos.title: Bienvenidos a Nuevo Orleans
videos.overview: Starting fresh in New Orleans, Teresa quickly encounters rivals, shady politicians — and a new love interest. Back in Sinaloa, a thief makes trouble.

videos.title: Un Asunto de Familia
videos.overview: Raul and Teresa's fragile alliance is tested over a shipment. Tony goes missing, and disturbing clues turn up at his dorm.

videos.title: Hospitalidad Sureña
videos.overview: A risky purchase makes problems for Teresa with Joel, Marcel and Judge Lafayette. Birdie proves a loyal ally. A happy reunion hits a snag.

videos.title: La Maldición
videos.overview: Teresa's rendezvous with Eddie is cut short when Marcel makes a strike with deadly consequences. Boaz and Javier do some dirty work.

videos.title: Noche de las Chicas
videos.overview: An unintended casualty has painful repercussions for Teresa as she lands a promising deal. A surprising new love affair blooms.

videos.title: La Mujer en el Espejo
videos.overview: Teresa's team suffers a hard blow. Judge Lafayette pushes for a truce, but Marcel stays dead set on vengeance. Javier's risky romance is revealed.

videos.title: Amores Perros
videos.overview: Eddie and Teresa's romantic road trip to Nashville takes an ugly turn, while a boys bonding getaway for Pote and Tony also hits bumps.

videos.title: Secretos y Mentiras
videos.overview: An informant in Gordo's operation is exposed, prompting Team Teresa to hatch an elaborate plan. Tony learns a hard truth about his father.

videos.title: Los Pecados de los Padres
videos.overview: Running out of time to stop the snitch, Teresa and Pote take drastic measures. Emilia faces a tough choice when she's interrogated by Lafayette.

videos.title: Lo Que Más Temes
videos.overview: Bills come due when Kelly Anne sniffs out a banker's betrayal. With Pote and Teresa's support, Tony takes steps to a new life. Tragedy strikes.

videos.title: Mientras Dormías
videos.overview: An explosive twist has far-reaching fallout, and Pote scrambles to pick up the pieces. Javier and Boaz have a bloody confrontation over Emilia.

videos.title: Diosa de la Guerra
videos.overview: Out for revenge, Teresa meets her match as she dodges deceptions and death threats to find a killer ⁠— and make him pay.

videos.title: Vienen Por Ti
videos.overview: Karma, confessions and revenge have fatal consequences for both sides of a brutal battle in New Orleans.

videos.title: Fantasmas
videos.overview: Teresa’s loyalty is tested when authorities search for Marcel. George grows suspicious when an old friend reappears.

videos.title: Me Llevo Manhattan
videos.overview: Tensions flare between the Dominicans and the Russians as Teresa works to secure capital for a major venture and more corruption comes to light.

videos.title: No Te Pierdas La Cabeza
videos.overview: James sets out on a rescue mission, while Teresa goes to extreme lengths to protect a valuable asset in the cartel.

videos.title: La Situacion
videos.overview: With Marcel behind bars, Teresa finds herself in the middle of the FBI's affairs and making more enemies.

videos.title: Mas Dinero Mas Problemas
videos.overview: Teresa and her crew lend a hand to Oksana after a botched deal with German art dealers. James questions a new deal for expansion.

videos.title: Plata o Plomo
videos.overview: An old grudge resurfaces in Europe as Teresa tries to expand the business. In Miami, George keeps an eye on Boaz.

videos.title: El Zorro en La Gallinera
videos.overview: A lavish party marks a new chapter for Teresa and the team. But an ambush during the celebration puts everyone — and the operation — in danger.

videos.title: Todo Lo Que Toco
videos.overview: After her trusted friend is kidnapped, Teresa hunts down a ruthless adversary. Marcel considers a new life.

videos.title: A Prueba de Balas
videos.overview: While Kelly Anne and Pote adapt to life in a suburban neighborhood, Teresa and James devise a risky plan to get out of the business for good.

videos.title: El Final
videos.overview: In the aftermath of the shooting, Pote, James and Kelly Anne try to make their escape until things take a turn.
